name: PT Era Graharealty Tbk
summary: PT Era Graharealty Tbk, an Indonesian company, specializes in real estate brokerage, encompassing both property agency functions and acting as a franchisor for real estate agents. Established in 1991 with headquarters in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia, the firm was originally a subsidiary of PT Realti Indo Mandiri. However, effective August 12, 2022, PT Era Graharealty Tbk became a subsidiary of APAC Investment 2 Pte Ltd.
